name: CI: Add ubuntu-cuda builds to release.yml (#28186)
summary: Merged llama.cpp pull request adding ubuntu-cuda build jobs (CUDA 12.8/13.3, x64 and arm64) to the release workflow.
description: Pull request #28186 in ggml-org/llama.cpp adding Ubuntu CUDA packages to the release workflow: three jobs (CUDA 12.8/13.3, x64 and arm64) publish the builds, ship dependent libraries and match CI naming with the Windows jobs. NCCL was removed again before merge until its license redistribution is confirmed; cublasLt stays as a transitive dependency. Merged by CISC 14 Sep 2026 with 14 commits.
contains: adds ubuntu-cuda build jobs (12.8/13.3, x64 + arm64) to release.yml
ships dependent libraries with the Ubuntu packages
NCCL dropped before merge until its license is confirmed; cublasLt kept as a transitive dependency
release ccache moved to HF to avoid thrashing the GHA cache
